headline: Nvidia Invests $3.5 Billion in MediaTek and Opens NVLink to Custom Chips
summary: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion in convertible bonds issued by MediaTek. The chip designers are expanding their partnership, including opening NVLink to custom chips.
why: MediaTek is a Taiwan-based chip designer, and Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerators, so ties between them matter for the semiconductor supply chain.

impacts.name: MediaTek
impacts.why: Receiving a $3.5 billion investment and a wider Nvidia partnership strengthens MediaTek's funding and custom-chip position.
